parts.text: Edit this image: the gold hoses coming from the valves of the two chrome air tanks on his back must run forward over his shoulder and plug clearly into ports on the side and back of his NECK, with riveted chrome collar sockets where they connect; no hose ends loose. Keep everything else exactly the same: gold mask, blue-flame chrome machete, chrome axe on his shoulder, armored body, space shuttle background, clay style.
